about: ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010:2022 stakeholders of the community model. Each is a role a pinned source names, with the sentence that names it; the projector refuses any stakeholder whose quote is not in its source. kind is the Schema.org type of whoever holds the role.

stakeholders.name: Board of Directors
stakeholders.quote: Ultimate enforcement authority rests with the Board of Directors

stakeholders.name: Organization Owner
stakeholders.quote: | Organization Owner | Final governance decisions and escalations |

stakeholders.name: Technical Oversight Committee
stakeholders.quote: a Technical Oversight Committee responsible for stewarding the UOR Framework specification, open-source repositories, and public API infrastructure

stakeholders.name: Community and Outreach Committee
stakeholders.quote: Community and Outreach Committee responsible for supporting the open developer, researcher, and practitioner community engaged with the UOR Framework

stakeholders.name: Repository Maintainer
stakeholders.quote: | Repository Maintainer | Day-to-day repo health, review, and release |

stakeholders.name: Contributor
stakeholders.quote: | Contributor | Proposes and ships improvements through PRs |

stakeholders.name: Agent contributor
stakeholders.quote: A software agent is running software.

stakeholders.name: Community Moderator
stakeholders.quote: Community Moderators take reports of violations seriously

stakeholders.name: Community participant
stakeholders.quote: This Code of Conduct applies to all participants, contributors, and representatives of the UOR Foundation.

stakeholders.name: Adopter
stakeholders.quote: At least one adopter or clear integration usage
